scope: exploratory after prior pilot transfer and long-run source/geometry results; before any long-run target test endpoints; validation search ongoing
endpoint: long-run test accuracy minus same seed/target/budget/mode random accuracy
folds: leave one entire source task group out, including every initialization and target; fit separately for each of five readouts and two budgets
preprocessing: feature mean/std fitted on training fold only, std floor 1e-8; intercept unpenalized
baseline_features: source label mean marginal conditional entropy given length
source label joint conditional entropy given length
mean absolute pairwise source correlation residualized by length
max source-target conditional categorical MI given length
mean source-target conditional categorical MI given length
math_features: mean exact source-answer transformed categorical CKA within length over C R RC I
geometry_features: mean same-group cross-seed trained source-query-concat CKA within length for current seed
mean transformed source-query-concat CKA within length over C R RC I
reporting: all five readouts, both label budgets, all variants and every heldout group; no test-based selection of feature set or ridge parameter
limits: one input world, eight source sets, three initialization seeds; correlated rows, no causal interpretation
mathematical feature formulas know true source task definitions, and MI uses unexposed target labels on source-training inputs as an analytical similarity reference
geometry landmarks were chosen after source measurements; not a prespecified primary endpoint or independent replication
